prompt: Estimate the points for one billable video request, ask the user to confirm, then submit exactly the same request with the returned estimate ID.
constraints: Do not write Canvas state during estimation.
Freeze the complete final prompt before estimating, including every reference binding token and prompt constraint.
For a provider asset such as asset://virtual-human-asset-id, keep it as an opaque generation reference and do not call visual_understanding.
Do not submit generation before explicit user confirmation.
After confirmation, submit the same item_ref and request byte-for-byte with the returned estimate ID.
Re-estimate when any billable generation parameter changes.
